name: Verify Counseling Protocol, Open Q&A & Safety Guardrails
description: Kiro agent hook that triggers whenever the AI service, schema, or steering prompt is updated to ensure the 1-question-at-a-time rule, open-ended user question handling, Phase 1 financial constraint logic, Zod validation, and mandatory crisis intervention stay in sync.

action.prompt: Verify that src/services/counselorAI.js, src/services/soulDossierEngine.js, src/ghostSchema.js, src/components/AiConsentModal.jsx, src/App.jsx, and vite.config.js strictly adhere to .kiro/steering/friendly_ghost_counselor_system_prompt.md and .kiro/rules.md: (1) Only one question is asked per turn while any direct user question is answered first, (2) Phase 1 Reality Check constraints prevent recommending unaffordable 4-year out-of-state universities when finances are tight, (3) all AI responses validate against GhostResponseSchema and custom Tarot cards validate against CustomTarotCardSchema with zero em dashes, (4) MANDATORY_SAFETY_RESPONSE triggers immediately on self-harm/abuse crisis keywords and isHarmfulContentBlocked plus the top-of-prompt No-Reframing Safety Rule refuse violence, animal cruelty, sexually explicit/porn/fetish content, illegal acts, and hate speech without updating Soul Dossier traits or Tarot cards, (5) Cloud vs. Offline AI consent is enforced and webcam biometrics are never sent to external APIs, (6) when any Chat Aligned Tarot card exists, unaligned filler cards are hidden while keeping all 14 classic cards intact, and (7) no plaintext role passcodes exist in source or client bundles.
